A day for each feast

First Sunday of Advent

First Sunday of Advent at Home

Celebrate the First Sunday of Advent by embracing hope and reflection with time-honored traditions and comforting seasonal flavors.

  1. Morning

    Light the First Advent Candle

    Begin the day by lighting the first candle on your Advent wreath, symbolizing hope as you prepare your heart for the Christmas season.

  2. Late Morning

    Jesse Tree Devotions

    Gather the family for Jesse Tree devotions, exploring the biblical stories leading to Christ’s birth and deepening your spiritual connection.

  3. Noon

    Quiet Reflection Time

    Set aside time for personal or family reflection, journaling thoughts of hope and gratitude in the peaceful Advent spirit.

  4. Afternoon

    Bake German Stollen and Lebkuchen

    Prepare traditional German Stollen and Lebkuchen to enjoy later; these festive treats bring sweetness and warmth to your Advent celebration.

    Recipes: German Stollen · Lebkuchen

  5. Late Afternoon

    Prepare Mulled Cider

    Simmer a pot of fragrant mulled cider, filling your home with seasonal spices and creating a cozy atmosphere for the evening.

    Recipes: Mulled Cider

  6. Early Evening

    Attend Worship or Personal Prayer

    Participate in a local worship service or enjoy a quiet time of prayer at home, focusing on the hopeful anticipation of Advent.

  7. Evening

    Enjoy Sunday Roast and Seasonal Treats

    Share a simple Sunday roast meal together, followed by slices of German Stollen and Lebkuchen, accompanied by warm mulled cider to conclude the day.

    Recipes: Traditional Sunday Roast · German Stollen · Lebkuchen · Mulled Cider

End your First Sunday of Advent with hearts full of hope and the joy of shared traditions.
